gaps.sentence: The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.

gaps.sentence: She ___ down an offer from a rival university.
I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: She was brought ___ by her grandparents.
gaps.explanation: bring up a child = raise, educate them.

gaps.sentence: They've just moved ___ to their new flat.
gaps.explanation: move in = start living in a new home.

gaps.sentence: They get ___ on very little money.
gaps.explanation: get by = manage to survive (with difficulty).

gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
